normal_bake_reference_parity.additional_checks: Material alpha/filter mutations, disabled shadows, dense grid and current 1/4/20/70-worker parity

superseded_investigations: Early overlapping-spot trials matched footprints but missed true source positions. Final search adds residual spatial seeds, source-grid relocation and joint refinement, and passes both parameter and full rebuild gates.
An overlap request capped at 700 million work units exhausted its bound and preserved the prior report. Final overlap controls explicitly allow one billion; this is no speedup or fixed runtime claim.

The initial dense stride-one bounced-scene negative control exhausted 700 million work units. Final matrices use stride two, consistent with the preceding point-material scene, complete within budget and reject the direct-only hypothesis.
The first unoptimized Debug sanitizer matrix was deliberately stopped after one positive case; the complete matrix and twelve related groups were rerun on the final -g -O1 Debug ASan/UBSan binary.

scratch_cleanup.qualification: Absolute project-local targets and all path/tree links were checked before requesting deletion. The rejected cleanup was not retried. Logs, reference binary, fixtures and this evidence generator are retained intentionally.

limits: Synthetic native rooms under declared current assets and encoding do not establish general author-light reconstruction accuracy or unique light/target identity. Withheld blocks belong to one BSP rather than independent scenes.

Bounded local search, residual seeding, finite refinement and intensity/source ceilings can miss better explanations. The native inverse-square spotlight family has fixed angle/falloff rules; custom falloff, dark/jittered lights and automatic mixed-family selection remain open.

Current entity/material/sky sources remain fixed. Original bake calibration, indirect light, complete material provenance, original normals/nudges and requested adaptive subsampling are not reconstructed.

Only unique static info_null/target_position markers without models or outgoing target/target2 links are eligible. Current origins are an assumption; five-degree matching plus a 0.01 training-MSE preference does not prove original target identity.
Reports propose new or retained target links but do not edit BSP/MAP entities. Automatic entity export and GUI acceptance/review remain open.

Training encodes continuous sRGB for derivatives; reported qualification and ordinary bakes use native byte conversion. Saturated/unknown observations remain excluded. Broader trace-exhaustion and resource-limit qualification remains open.

Linux Release skips GPU area_factors; this round adds no GPU backend or measured performance gain. No editor, game renderer, screen capture or input control was used; portable packages were not refreshed.

No external code was incorporated. Older policy-blocked cleanup targets were not retried. Existing parser-sign/include-line findings, compiler warnings, VIS discrepancies, sidecar publication and intermittent Windows process delays remain outside this round.
Intelligent compiler optimization, broader recovery, M11 Radiant patch RGB/alpha painting and per-surface lightmap density/preview remain open.
